name: tab01
definition: 主数据实体一 Counterexample: 与 tab02 的区分：tab02 含 fld002 但另有 fld004、fld005、fld006，属于另一类记录，不是本主数据实体的实例 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab01; provenance: direct source tab01

name: tab02
definition: 业务记录二 Counterexample: 与 tab01 的区分：tab01 为被引用的主数据，tab02 为带自身属性列 fld005、fld006 的业务记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab02; provenance: direct source tab02

name: tab03
definition: 业务记录三 Counterexample: 与 tab04 的区分：tab03 仅两列且被 tab04 引用，属被引用的基础记录，而非承载多外键的关联记录 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab03; provenance: direct source tab03

name: tab04
definition: 业务关联记录四 Counterexample: 与 tab05 的区分：tab05 仅含 fld001、fld010、fld015 三列，是较窄的记录；tab04 承载更多属性列与多个引用列，二者不是同一实体 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab04; provenance: direct source tab04

name: tab05
definition: 业务记录五 Counterexample: 与 tab04 的区分：tab04 含 fld004、fld007 等额外引用列，tab05 不含，二者为不同记录类型 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table tab05; provenance: direct source tab05

name: Country
definition: 国家代码，标识加油站所在国家

name: Currency
definition: 交易使用的货币代码

name: CustomerSegment
definition: 客户或加油站的细分类型

name: TransactionDate
definition: 交易发生的日期或年月

name: TransactionTime
definition: 交易发生的具体时间

name: GasConsumption
definition: 交易消耗的油量

name: Quantity
definition: 单笔交易购买的数量

name: Price
definition: 交易金额

name: ProductDescription
definition: 交易产品的描述

name: Customer
definition: 交易客户标识

name: EURtoCZKRatio
definition: 以欧元支付的客户数与以捷克克朗支付的客户数之比 Formula: COUNT(Currency='EUR') / COUNT(Currency='CZK'). Inputs: Currency = tab01.fld003
aliases: ratio of EUR to CZK customers

name: SMEPaymentDifference
definition: SME以CZK支付数与以EUR支付数之差 Formula: COUNT(CustomerSegment='SME' AND Currency='CZK') - COUNT(CustomerSegment='SME' AND Currency='EUR'). Inputs: CustomerSegment = tab01.fld001; Currency = tab01.fld003
aliases: more SMEs pay in CZK than EUR

name: ConsumptionDifferenceCZKvsEUR
definition: CZK支付客户与EUR支付客户的油量消耗之差 Formula: SUM(GasConsumption WHERE Currency='CZK') - SUM(GasConsumption WHERE Currency='EUR'). Inputs: GasConsumption = tab05.fld015; Currency = tab01.fld003
aliases: difference in gas consumption between CZK and EUR

name: PremiumSegmentPercentage
definition: premium细分在整体细分中的占比 Formula: COUNT(CustomerSegment='premium') / COUNT(CustomerSegment). Inputs: CustomerSegment = tab01.fld001

name: DiscountStationDifference
definition: 捷克与斯洛伐克discount加油站数量之差 Formula: COUNT(Country='CZE' AND CustomerSegment='discount') - COUNT(Country='SVK' AND CustomerSegment='discount'). Inputs: Country = tab01.fld002; CustomerSegment = tab01.fld001

name: AveragePricePerItem
definition: 每件商品的平均价格 Formula: SUM(Price) / SUM(Quantity). Inputs: Price = tab04.fld014; Quantity = tab04.fld013

name: HighConsumptionCustomerPercentage
definition: 消耗量超过528.3的客户占比 Formula: COUNT(GasConsumption > 528.3) / COUNT(Customer). Inputs: GasConsumption = tab05.fld015; Customer = tab04.fld012
aliases: percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3

name: Currency
definition: 按支付货币分析交易与客户
